AC-0044 — leaf/flower transparency (black background in web build): FIXED

Root cause

The saved texture atlas godot/assets/blocks_atlas.png had lost its alpha channel: every pixel was fully opaque (alpha = 255), and the transparent gaps of the leaf/flower tiles were filled black. The chunk materials were already correct (TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA_SCISSOR, threshold 0.5, chunk.gd:413), so the scissor test never discarded a fragment and leaves/flowers rendered as green-on-black cutout squares. Evidence (headless probe godot/probe_alpha.gd, Godot Image pixel counts):

Source (Faithful-32x mcpack)Old saved atlas
oak_leaves.png — 294 px with alpha < 0.5oak leaf tile — 0 transparent px, center #000000ff
poppy.png — 887 px with alpha < 0.5poppy tile — 0 transparent px
dandelion.png — 919 px with alpha < 0.5dandelion tile — 0 transparent px

The old atlas was generated by an earlier broken import and persisted forever, because Atlas.import_pack() (godot/core/atlas.gd:66) skips every block whose rect already exists in blocks_atlas.json — re-importing with AWECRAFT_IMPORT_PACK only adds missing tiles and never re-bakes existing ones. The current import code is correct (verified: a fresh import reproduces the exact source alpha counts).

Fix

# 1. deleted stale  godot/assets/blocks_atlas.png, blocks_atlas.json (+ .import)
# 2. re-imported fresh from the pack (single godot run):
#    AWECRAFT_IMPORT_PACK=.../Faithful-32x-1.21.11.mcpack godot --headless --path godot
# 3. regenerated texture import: godot --headless --path godot --import
# 4. rebuilt web: ./build_web.sh

New atlas verified pixel-for-pixel against the pack: leaf tile 294 / poppy 887 / dandelion 919 transparent px — identical to source. No material, UV, or tint changes; leaf tint [60,140,48] untouched.

Files changed

  • godot/assets/blocks_atlas.png — regenerated from the Faithful-32x pack (alpha restored)
  • godot/assets/blocks_atlas.json — regenerated (fresh tile layout)
  • godot/assets/blocks_atlas.png.import — regenerated by --import (same params as before)
  • godot/probe_alpha.gd — repaired (void/in-place Image.convert(), removed non-existent is_srgb(), always quit()); kept as the atlas-alpha verification tool
  • web/ — rebuilt via build_web.sh

Deviation / note

Stale-tile trap remains in Atlas.import_pack(): if a tile is ever written wrong again, a plain re-import will not fix it (existing rects are skipped). Not changed here (spec asks for a targeted fix); probe_alpha.gd now catches this. tasks/AC-0044/atlas_before.png = the stale opaque atlas, kept as evidence.
